####################################################################################################
Purpose: This script accesses requested studies, verifies their receipt, and ensures they are saved. 

Data:
There are two copies of the studies (zipped):
- one in the kramer server folder
- one in the bg/gsk_data_save server folder
There is one working copy of the studies (unzipped and organized):
- in the bg/gsk_data folder 

Output:
- stu_req (data frame) requested studies with receipt status
####################################################################################################

# Set the working directory to the project directory
```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '~/Nextcloud/Projects/_seas_imm/code_exp_imm')
```

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
source("00_pck.R")
```

# Load the list of requested studies
```{r}
stu_req <- read_excel(glue("{dirs$raw}/studies_requested.xlsx")) %>%
  # Tidy study IDs
  rename(study = study_id) %>%
  mutate(study = str_remove(study, pattern = "GSK-"),
         study = gsub(" .*", "", study),
         study = case_when(study == "RTX114351" ~ "114351",
                           study == "V72P12" ~ "205399",
                           study == "V72P13E1" ~ "205453",
                           study == "V72P13" ~ "205450",
                           TRUE ~ as.character(study)),
         study = str_replace(study, "/", "-"))
```

# Load studies from the two "saved zipped" folders and check for overlap
```{r}
# Studies in Kramer's server zipped data
save_kramer_l <- str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$server_save_kramer}")), negate = TRUE, 
                            "allStudies_Apr.csv|resources_for_Laura.zip|seasonal_immunogenicity|vacc_con dataset")
# Studies in Barrero Guevaras's server zipped data (classified)
save_bg_l <- sapply(list.files(glue("{dirs$server_save_bg}")), simplify = FALSE,
                    function(x) list.files(glue("{dirs$server_save_bg}/{x}")))

# Check that all studies are saved in both kramer and bg zipped folders
all(str_sort(unlist(save_bg_l)) == str_sort(save_kramer_l))
```
Note: There is a folder with 12 studies "unclassified", which includes studies for which newer 
versions were received. The newer versions are the ones analyzed.

# Check if the requested studies were received
```{r}
# Load requested studies and mark receipt status
stu_req <- mutate(stu_req, received = study %in% str_subset(save_kramer_l, "new", negate = T)) %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(lapply(save_bg_l, data.frame), .id = "stu_pat_tidy") %>%
              rename(study = 2))

# Display studies not received (8 studies)
filter(stu_req, received == F)
```

# Load studies from the "working unzipped" folder and check overlap with received studies
```{r}
working_l <- sapply(list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}")), 
               function(x) list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{x}")), simplify = FALSE)

length(unlist(working_l)) == length(filter(stu_req, received == TRUE)[[1]])
```

# Save the data frame of requested and received studies
```{r}
saveRDS(stu_req, file = glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_req.rds"))
```
